Guide to completing your CPD log

This CPD log summarizes professional development activities completed by the recipient during the stated
 CPD period. This record has been issued by the named CPD provider and may be verified using the QR code 
or credential ID. CPD hours are based on completed activities listed in this record. This document may be 
retained for professional renewal, employer review, or audit purposes.

Record completed CPD activities for the stated CPD period. Include relevant learning outcomes, reflection, evidence, and hours. CPD requirements may vary by profession, 
regulator, country, or professional body. Keep this record for renewal, employer review, or audit purposes.
